captions: It's Friday. And your calendar is full.
A call at one. Another at two.
The adhan rings out. You keep typing.
Last Friday was “just this once” too.
So today, you close the laptop.
You walk in. You find your place in the row.
The world can wait one hour.

verses.text: “O you who have believed, when [the adhan] is called for the prayer on the day of Jumu'ah [Friday], then proceed to the remembrance of Allah and leave trade.”

hook.text: 8 hours for your boss today. 1 hour for Allah?

end.text: 8 hours for your boss today. 1 hour for Allah?
end.gold: Next Friday, 12:30: close the laptop. Go to Jumu'ah.
